description: This Java source file defines the class DateOrDatetimeEditor, which is a property editor supporting conversion between String representations and java.util.Date objects, handling both date and datetime formats without partial data support.

classes.name: DateOrDatetimeEditor
classes.description: A property editor that converts a String to a Date and vice versa, supporting date and datetime formats.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a String to a Date object, trying datetime format first, then date format, and throwing an exception if both fail.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Converts a Date object to its String representation, choosing date or datetime format based on whether the time component is zero.
